anomalies.description: Two individuals in an aisle: one (male, black shirt) reaches toward a shelf and appears to conceal an item in his clothing or pocket while the other (female, blue shirt) stands close, possibly acting as a lookout. Their coordinated positioning, sudden focus on a specific shelf item, and lack of basket/bag suggest potential shoplifting via concealment.

One individual (in dark clothing) appears to be concealing an item from a shelf into their clothing or bag while the other person (in blue shirt) stands close, partially obscuring the action. anomalies.description: The two individuals are closely positioned in an aisle; the person in the black hoodie leans over and appears to place an item from the shelf into the pocket or waistband of the person in the blue shirt, who is turned away and partially obscuring the action. This behavior is consistent with covert shoplifting—concealing merchandise without payment—especially given the proximity, timing, and lack of visible basket or cart.
